title: Centrifugal Pump Safety Requirements Specification
description: OMG ReqIF 1.2 specification defining five core pressure, temperature, and over-speed safety requirements for an industrial centrifugal pump.
code:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<REQ-IF xmlns="http://www.omg.org/spec/ReqIF/20110401/reqif.xsd">
  <THE-HEADER>
    <REQ-IF-HEADER IDENTIFIER="HDR-PUMP-01">
      <CREATION-TIME>2026-11-01T09:00:00Z</CREATION-TIME>
      <REQ-IF-VERSION>1.0</REQ-IF-VERSION>
      <TITLE>Industrial Centrifugal Pump Safety Specification</TITLE>
      <COMMENT>Baseline mechanical and thermal safety limits</COMMENT>
    </REQ-IF-HEADER>
  </THE-HEADER>
  <CORE-CONTENT>
    <REQ-IF-CONTENT>
      <DATATYPES>
        <DATATYPE-DEFINITION-STRING IDENTIFIER="DT-STR" LONG-NAME="String" />
      </DATATYPES>
      <SPEC-TYPES>
        <SPEC-OBJECT-TYPE IDENTIFIER="ST-REQ" LONG-NAME="Safety Requirement">
          <SPEC-ATTRIBUTES>
            <ATTRIBUTE-DEFINITION-STRING IDENTIFIER="AD-TEXT" LONG-NAME="Description" IS-MANDATORY="true">
              <TYPE><DATATYPE-DEFINITION-STRING-REF>DT-STR</DATATYPE-DEFINITION-STRING-REF></TYPE>
            </ATTRIBUTE-DEFINITION-STRING>
          </SPEC-ATTRIBUTES>
        </SPEC-OBJECT-TYPE>
      </SPEC-TYPES>
      <SPEC-OBJECTS>
        <SPEC-OBJECT IDENTIFIER="REQ-PUMP-01" LONG-NAME="Maximum Discharge Pressure">
          <TYPE><SPEC-OBJECT-TYPE-REF>ST-REQ</SPEC-OBJECT-TYPE-REF></TYPE>
          <VALUES>
            <ATTRIBUTE-VALUE-STRING>
              <DEFINITION><ATTRIBUTE-DEFINITION-STRING-REF>AD-TEXT</ATTRIBUTE-DEFINITION-STRING-REF></DEFINITION>
              <THE-VALUE>Discharge pressure must be <= 16 bar under continuous rated operation.</THE-VALUE>
            </ATTRIBUTE-VALUE-STRING>
          </VALUES>
        </SPEC-OBJECT>
        <SPEC-OBJECT IDENTIFIER="REQ-PUMP-02" LONG-NAME="Bearing Temperature Limit">
          <TYPE><SPEC-OBJECT-TYPE-REF>ST-REQ</SPEC-OBJECT-TYPE-REF></TYPE>
          <VALUES>
            <ATTRIBUTE-VALUE-STRING>
              <DEFINITION><ATTRIBUTE-DEFINITION-STRING-REF>AD-TEXT</ATTRIBUTE-DEFINITION-STRING-REF></DEFINITION>
              <THE-VALUE>Bearing temperature must be <= 85 degC during full-load operation.</THE-VALUE>
            </ATTRIBUTE-VALUE-STRING>
          </VALUES>
        </SPEC-OBJECT>
        <SPEC-OBJECT IDENTIFIER="REQ-PUMP-03" LONG-NAME="Minimum NPSH Margin">
          <TYPE><SPEC-OBJECT-TYPE-REF>ST-REQ</SPEC-OBJECT-TYPE-REF></TYPE>
          <VALUES>
            <ATTRIBUTE-VALUE-STRING>
              <DEFINITION><ATTRIBUTE-DEFINITION-STRING-REF>AD-TEXT</ATTRIBUTE-DEFINITION-STRING-REF></DEFINITION>
              <THE-VALUE>Available net positive suction head must be >= 2.5 m above required NPSH.</THE-VALUE>
            </ATTRIBUTE-VALUE-STRING>
          </VALUES>
        </SPEC-OBJECT>
        <SPEC-OBJECT IDENTIFIER="REQ-PUMP-04" LONG-NAME="Overspeed Trip Threshold">
          <TYPE><SPEC-OBJECT-TYPE-REF>ST-REQ</SPEC-OBJECT-TYPE-REF></TYPE>
          <VALUES>
            <ATTRIBUTE-VALUE-STRING>
              <DEFINITION><ATTRIBUTE-DEFINITION-STRING-REF>AD-TEXT</ATTRIBUTE-DEFINITION-STRING-REF></DEFINITION>
              <THE-VALUE>Shaft speed must be <= 3600 rpm before automatic overspeed trip engagement.</THE-VALUE>
            </ATTRIBUTE-VALUE-STRING>
          </VALUES>
        </SPEC-OBJECT>
        <SPEC-OBJECT IDENTIFIER="REQ-PUMP-05" LONG-NAME="Dry-Run Shutdown Time">
          <TYPE><SPEC-OBJECT-TYPE-REF>ST-REQ</SPEC-OBJECT-TYPE-REF></TYPE>
          <VALUES>
            <ATTRIBUTE-VALUE-STRING>
              <DEFINITION><ATTRIBUTE-DEFINITION-STRING-REF>AD-TEXT</ATTRIBUTE-DEFINITION-STRING-REF></DEFINITION>
              <THE-VALUE>Dry-run protection shall de-energize the motor within <= 3.0 s of suction loss.</THE-VALUE>
            </ATTRIBUTE-VALUE-STRING>
          </VALUES>
        </SPEC-OBJECT>
      </SPEC-OBJECTS>
      <SPECIFICATIONS>
        <SPECIFICATION IDENTIFIER="SPEC-PUMP" LONG-NAME="Pump Safety Spec">
          <CHILDREN>
            <SPEC-HIERARCHY IDENTIFIER="H-01"><OBJECT><SPEC-OBJECT-REF>REQ-PUMP-01</SPEC-OBJECT-REF></OBJECT></SPEC-HIERARCHY>
            <SPEC-HIERARCHY IDENTIFIER="H-02"><OBJECT><SPEC-OBJECT-REF>REQ-PUMP-02</SPEC-OBJECT-REF></OBJECT></SPEC-HIERARCHY>
            <SPEC-HIERARCHY IDENTIFIER="H-03"><OBJECT><SPEC-OBJECT-REF>REQ-PUMP-03</SPEC-OBJECT-REF></OBJECT></SPEC-HIERARCHY>
            <SPEC-HIERARCHY IDENTIFIER="H-04"><OBJECT><SPEC-OBJECT-REF>REQ-PUMP-04</SPEC-OBJECT-REF></OBJECT></SPEC-HIERARCHY>
            <SPEC-HIERARCHY IDENTIFIER="H-05"><OBJECT><SPEC-OBJECT-REF>REQ-PUMP-05</SPEC-OBJECT-REF></OBJECT></SPEC-HIERARCHY>
          </CHILDREN>
        </SPECIFICATION>
      </SPECIFICATIONS>
    </REQ-IF-CONTENT>
  </CORE-CONTENT>
</REQ-IF>

title: ISO 26262 ASIL-D Brake-by-Wire Specification
description: Automotive functional safety ReqIF specification with ASIL enumerations, braking latency contracts, and safety-goal refinement links.
code:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<REQ-IF xmlns="http://www.omg.org/spec/ReqIF/20110401/reqif.xsd">
  <THE-HEADER>
    <REQ-IF-HEADER IDENTIFIER="HDR-BBW-01">
      <CREATION-TIME>2026-11-01T10:00:00Z</CREATION-TIME>
      <REQ-IF-VERSION>1.0</REQ-IF-VERSION>
      <TITLE>ISO 26262 ASIL-D Brake-by-Wire Functional Safety Spec</TITLE>
      <COMMENT>Safety goals and technical safety requirements</COMMENT>
    </REQ-IF-HEADER>
  </THE-HEADER>
  <CORE-CONTENT>
    <REQ-IF-CONTENT>
      <DATATYPES>
        <DATATYPE-DEFINITION-STRING IDENTIFIER="DT-STR" LONG-NAME="String" />
        <DATATYPE-DEFINITION-ENUMERATION IDENTIFIER="DT-ASIL" LONG-NAME="ASIL">
          <SPECIFIED-VALUES>
            <ENUM-VALUE IDENTIFIER="EV-QM" LONG-NAME="QM" KEY="0" />
            <ENUM-VALUE IDENTIFIER="EV-ASIL-B" LONG-NAME="ASIL-B" KEY="2" />
            <ENUM-VALUE IDENTIFIER="EV-ASIL-D" LONG-NAME="ASIL-D" KEY="4" />
          </SPECIFIED-VALUES>
        </DATATYPE-DEFINITION-ENUMERATION>
      </DATATYPES>
      <SPEC-TYPES>
        <SPEC-OBJECT-TYPE IDENTIFIER="ST-FSR" LONG-NAME="Functional Safety Requirement">
          <SPEC-ATTRIBUTES>
            <ATTRIBUTE-DEFINITION-STRING IDENTIFIER="AD-DESC" LONG-NAME="Description" IS-MANDATORY="true">
              <TYPE><DATATYPE-DEFINITION-STRING-REF>DT-STR</DATATYPE-DEFINITION-STRING-REF></TYPE>
            </ATTRIBUTE-DEFINITION-STRING>
          </SPEC-ATTRIBUTES>
        </SPEC-OBJECT-TYPE>
      </SPEC-TYPES>
      <SPEC-OBJECTS>
        <SPEC-OBJECT IDENTIFIER="SG-BBW-01" LONG-NAME="Prevent Unintended Loss of Braking">
          <TYPE><SPEC-OBJECT-TYPE-REF>ST-FSR</SPEC-OBJECT-TYPE-REF></TYPE>
          <VALUES>
            <ATTRIBUTE-VALUE-STRING>
              <DEFINITION><ATTRIBUTE-DEFINITION-STRING-REF>AD-DESC</ATTRIBUTE-DEFINITION-STRING-REF></DEFINITION>
              <THE-VALUE>Deceleration must be >= 6.4 m/s2 during single-channel fault fallback. ASIL-D.</THE-VALUE>
            </ATTRIBUTE-VALUE-STRING>
          </VALUES>
        </SPEC-OBJECT>
        <SPEC-OBJECT IDENTIFIER="TSR-BBW-02" LONG-NAME="Pedal-to-Caliper Response Time">
          <TYPE><SPEC-OBJECT-TYPE-REF>ST-FSR</SPEC-OBJECT-TYPE-REF></TYPE>
          <VALUES>
            <ATTRIBUTE-VALUE-STRING>
              <DEFINITION><ATTRIBUTE-DEFINITION-STRING-REF>AD-DESC</ATTRIBUTE-DEFINITION-STRING-REF></DEFINITION>
              <THE-VALUE>Actuation latency must be <= 12 ms from pedal sensor read to caliper torque command. ASIL-D.</THE-VALUE>
            </ATTRIBUTE-VALUE-STRING>
          </VALUES>
        </SPEC-OBJECT>
        <SPEC-OBJECT IDENTIFIER="TSR-BBW-03" LONG-NAME="Redundant Power Bus Voltage">
          <TYPE><SPEC-OBJECT-TYPE-REF>ST-FSR</SPEC-OBJECT-TYPE-REF></TYPE>
          <VALUES>
            <ATTRIBUTE-VALUE-STRING>
              <DEFINITION><ATTRIBUTE-DEFINITION-STRING-REF>AD-DESC</ATTRIBUTE-DEFINITION-STRING-REF></DEFINITION>
              <THE-VALUE>Dual-rail 48V supply voltage must be >= 42 V under emergency braking load. ASIL-D.</THE-VALUE>
            </ATTRIBUTE-VALUE-STRING>
          </VALUES>
        </SPEC-OBJECT>
      </SPEC-OBJECTS>
      <SPEC-RELATIONS>
        <SPEC-RELATION IDENTIFIER="REL-BBW-01" LONG-NAME="refines">
          <SOURCE><SPEC-OBJECT-REF>TSR-BBW-02</SPEC-OBJECT-REF></SOURCE>
          <TARGET><SPEC-OBJECT-REF>SG-BBW-01</SPEC-OBJECT-REF></TARGET>
        </SPEC-RELATION>
        <SPEC-RELATION IDENTIFIER="REL-BBW-02" LONG-NAME="refines">
          <SOURCE><SPEC-OBJECT-REF>TSR-BBW-03</SPEC-OBJECT-REF></SOURCE>
          <TARGET><SPEC-OBJECT-REF>SG-BBW-01</SPEC-OBJECT-REF></TARGET>
        </SPEC-RELATION>
      </SPEC-RELATIONS>
      <SPECIFICATIONS>
        <SPECIFICATION IDENTIFIER="SPEC-BBW" LONG-NAME="Brake-by-Wire Safety Spec">
          <CHILDREN>
            <SPEC-HIERARCHY IDENTIFIER="H-SG1">
              <OBJECT><SPEC-OBJECT-REF>SG-BBW-01</SPEC-OBJECT-REF></OBJECT>
              <CHILDREN>
                <SPEC-HIERARCHY IDENTIFIER="H-TSR2"><OBJECT><SPEC-OBJECT-REF>TSR-BBW-02</SPEC-OBJECT-REF></OBJECT></SPEC-HIERARCHY>
                <SPEC-HIERARCHY IDENTIFIER="H-TSR3"><OBJECT><SPEC-OBJECT-REF>TSR-BBW-03</SPEC-OBJECT-REF></OBJECT></SPEC-HIERARCHY>
              </CHILDREN>
            </SPEC-HIERARCHY>
          </CHILDREN>
        </SPECIFICATION>
      </SPECIFICATIONS>
    </REQ-IF-CONTENT>
  </CORE-CONTENT>
</REQ-IF>

title: DO-178C Flight Control Software Spec with Hierarchy & Links
description: DAL-A fly-by-wire flight control software specification organizing high-level and low-level requirements in a multi-level ReqIF hierarchy with traceability relations.
code:

<REQ-IF xmlns="http://www.omg.org/spec/ReqIF/20110401/reqif.xsd">
  <THE-HEADER>
    <REQ-IF-HEADER IDENTIFIER="HDR-FCS-01">

      <REQ-IF-VERSION>1.0</REQ-IF-VERSION>
      <TITLE>DO-178C DAL-A Primary Flight Control Software Specification</TITLE>

        <DATATYPE-DEFINITION-STRING IDENTIFIER="DT-STR" LONG-NAME="String" />

      <SPEC-TYPES>
        <SPEC-OBJECT-TYPE IDENTIFIER="ST-HLR" LONG-NAME="High-Level Requirement">
          <SPEC-ATTRIBUTES>
            <ATTRIBUTE-DEFINITION-STRING IDENTIFIER="AD-DESC" LONG-NAME="Description" IS-MANDATORY="true">
              <TYPE><DATATYPE-DEFINITION-STRING-REF>DT-STR</DATATYPE-DEFINITION-STRING-REF></TYPE>

          </SPEC-ATTRIBUTES>
        </SPEC-OBJECT-TYPE>
      </SPEC-TYPES>

          <VALUES>
            <ATTRIBUTE-VALUE-STRING>
              <DEFINITION><ATTRIBUTE-DEFINITION-STRING-REF>AD-DESC</ATTRIBUTE-DEFINITION-STRING-REF></DEFINITION>
              <THE-VALUE>Commanded pitch attitude must be <= 30 deg nose-up in normal law.</THE-VALUE>
            </ATTRIBUTE-VALUE-STRING>

title: IEEE 2800 Inverter Ride-Through Compliance Matrix
description: Grid-interconnection ReqIF compliance specification encoding IEEE 2800-2022 voltage and frequency ride-through, reactive current injection, and harmonic distortion bounds.
code:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<REQ-IF xmlns="http://www.omg.org/spec/ReqIF/20110401/reqif.xsd">
  <THE-HEADER>
    <REQ-IF-HEADER IDENTIFIER="HDR-2800-01">
      <CREATION-TIME>2026-11-01T12:00:00Z</CREATION-TIME>
      <REQ-IF-VERSION>1.0</REQ-IF-VERSION>
      <TITLE>IEEE 2800-2022 Inverter-Based Resource Ride-Through Compliance Matrix</TITLE>
      <COMMENT>Transmission-connected IBR dynamic performance requirements</COMMENT>
    </REQ-IF-HEADER>
  </THE-HEADER>
  <CORE-CONTENT>
    <REQ-IF-CONTENT>
      <DATATYPES>
        <DATATYPE-DEFINITION-STRING IDENTIFIER="DT-STR" LONG-NAME="String" />
        <DATATYPE-DEFINITION-REAL IDENTIFIER="DT-REAL" LONG-NAME="Real" />
      </DATATYPES>
      <SPEC-TYPES>
        <SPEC-OBJECT-TYPE IDENTIFIER="ST-GRID" LONG-NAME="Grid Code Requirement">
          <SPEC-ATTRIBUTES>
            <ATTRIBUTE-DEFINITION-STRING IDENTIFIER="AD-DESC" LONG-NAME="Description" IS-MANDATORY="true">
              <TYPE><DATATYPE-DEFINITION-STRING-REF>DT-STR</DATATYPE-DEFINITION-STRING-REF></TYPE>
            </ATTRIBUTE-DEFINITION-STRING>
          </SPEC-ATTRIBUTES>
        </SPEC-OBJECT-TYPE>
      </SPEC-TYPES>
      <SPEC-OBJECTS>
        <SPEC-OBJECT IDENTIFIER="IBR-LVRT-01" LONG-NAME="Low-Voltage Ride-Through Duration">
          <TYPE><SPEC-OBJECT-TYPE-REF>ST-GRID</SPEC-OBJECT-TYPE-REF></TYPE>
          <VALUES>
            <ATTRIBUTE-VALUE-STRING>
              <DEFINITION><ATTRIBUTE-DEFINITION-STRING-REF>AD-DESC</ATTRIBUTE-DEFINITION-STRING-REF></DEFINITION>
              <THE-VALUE>Inverter shall ride through terminal voltage sag down to 0.10 pu for duration >= 0.32 s.</THE-VALUE>
            </ATTRIBUTE-VALUE-STRING>
          </VALUES>
        </SPEC-OBJECT>
        <SPEC-OBJECT IDENTIFIER="IBR-HVRT-02" LONG-NAME="High-Voltage Ride-Through Margin">
          <TYPE><SPEC-OBJECT-TYPE-REF>ST-GRID</SPEC-OBJECT-TYPE-REF></TYPE>
          <VALUES>
            <ATTRIBUTE-VALUE-STRING>
              <DEFINITION><ATTRIBUTE-DEFINITION-STRING-REF>AD-DESC</ATTRIBUTE-DEFINITION-STRING-REF></DEFINITION>
              <THE-VALUE>Inverter shall remain connected at 1.20 pu overvoltage for duration >= 0.20 s.</THE-VALUE>
            </ATTRIBUTE-VALUE-STRING>
          </VALUES>
        </SPEC-OBJECT>
        <SPEC-OBJECT IDENTIFIER="IBR-FRT-03" LONG-NAME="Continuous Frequency Operating Band">
          <TYPE><SPEC-OBJECT-TYPE-REF>ST-GRID</SPEC-OBJECT-TYPE-REF></TYPE>
          <VALUES>
            <ATTRIBUTE-VALUE-STRING>
              <DEFINITION><ATTRIBUTE-DEFINITION-STRING-REF>AD-DESC</ATTRIBUTE-DEFINITION-STRING-REF></DEFINITION>
              <THE-VALUE>Continuous operation shall be maintained for grid frequency >= 58.8 Hz.</THE-VALUE>
            </ATTRIBUTE-VALUE-STRING>
          </VALUES>
        </SPEC-OBJECT>
        <SPEC-OBJECT IDENTIFIER="IBR-FFR-04" LONG-NAME="Fast Frequency Response Reaction Time">
          <TYPE><SPEC-OBJECT-TYPE-REF>ST-GRID</SPEC-OBJECT-TYPE-REF></TYPE>
          <VALUES>
            <ATTRIBUTE-VALUE-STRING>
              <DEFINITION><ATTRIBUTE-DEFINITION-STRING-REF>AD-DESC</ATTRIBUTE-DEFINITION-STRING-REF></DEFINITION>
              <THE-VALUE>Active power step response reaction time must be <= 0.5 s following frequency excursion.</THE-VALUE>
            </ATTRIBUTE-VALUE-STRING>
          </VALUES>
        </SPEC-OBJECT>
        <SPEC-OBJECT IDENTIFIER="IBR-THD-05" LONG-NAME="Total Harmonic Current Distortion">
          <TYPE><SPEC-OBJECT-TYPE-REF>ST-GRID</SPEC-OBJECT-TYPE-REF></TYPE>
          <VALUES>
            <ATTRIBUTE-VALUE-STRING>
              <DEFINITION><ATTRIBUTE-DEFINITION-STRING-REF>AD-DESC</ATTRIBUTE-DEFINITION-STRING-REF></DEFINITION>
              <THE-VALUE>Injected current total rated-current distortion must be <= 5.0 percent at point of interconnection.</THE-VALUE>
            </ATTRIBUTE-VALUE-STRING>
          </VALUES>
        </SPEC-OBJECT>
      </SPEC-OBJECTS>
      <SPEC-RELATIONS>
        <SPEC-RELATION IDENTIFIER="REL-2800-01" LONG-NAME="supports">
          <SOURCE><SPEC-OBJECT-REF>IBR-FFR-04</SPEC-OBJECT-REF></SOURCE>
          <TARGET><SPEC-OBJECT-REF>IBR-FRT-03</SPEC-OBJECT-REF></TARGET>
        </SPEC-RELATION>
      </SPEC-RELATIONS>
      <SPECIFICATIONS>
        <SPECIFICATION IDENTIFIER="SPEC-2800" LONG-NAME="IEEE 2800 IBR Compliance">
          <CHILDREN>
            <SPEC-HIERARCHY IDENTIFIER="H-LVRT"><OBJECT><SPEC-OBJECT-REF>IBR-LVRT-01</SPEC-OBJECT-REF></OBJECT></SPEC-HIERARCHY>
            <SPEC-HIERARCHY IDENTIFIER="H-HVRT"><OBJECT><SPEC-OBJECT-REF>IBR-HVRT-02</SPEC-OBJECT-REF></OBJECT></SPEC-HIERARCHY>
            <SPEC-HIERARCHY IDENTIFIER="H-FRT">
              <OBJECT><SPEC-OBJECT-REF>IBR-FRT-03</SPEC-OBJECT-REF></OBJECT>
              <CHILDREN>
                <SPEC-HIERARCHY IDENTIFIER="H-FFR"><OBJECT><SPEC-OBJECT-REF>IBR-FFR-04</SPEC-OBJECT-REF></OBJECT></SPEC-HIERARCHY>
              </CHILDREN>
            </SPEC-HIERARCHY>
            <SPEC-HIERARCHY IDENTIFIER="H-THD"><OBJECT><SPEC-OBJECT-REF>IBR-THD-05</SPEC-OBJECT-REF></OBJECT></SPEC-HIERARCHY>
          </CHILDREN>
        </SPECIFICATION>
      </SPECIFICATIONS>
    </REQ-IF-CONTENT>
  </CORE-CONTENT>
</REQ-IF>

title: Submarine Pressure Hull & Life-Support Digital Thread
description: Multi-file ReqIF and SysML v2 verification bundle tracing deep-submergence hull collapse margin and O2/CO2 life-support requirements to SysML verification cases.
code:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<REQ-IF xmlns="http://www.omg.org/spec/ReqIF/20110401/reqif.xsd">
  <THE-HEADER>
    <REQ-IF-HEADER IDENTIFIER="HDR-SUB-01">
      <CREATION-TIME>2026-11-01T14:00:00Z</CREATION-TIME>
      <REQ-IF-VERSION>1.0</REQ-IF-VERSION>
      <TITLE>Deep-Submergence Submarine Hull and Life-Support Specification</TITLE>
      <COMMENT>Paired with HullVerification.sysml for digital-thread traceability</COMMENT>
    </REQ-IF-HEADER>
  </THE-HEADER>
  <CORE-CONTENT>
    <REQ-IF-CONTENT>
      <DATATYPES>
        <DATATYPE-DEFINITION-STRING IDENTIFIER="DT-STR" LONG-NAME="String" />
      </DATATYPES>
      <SPEC-TYPES>
        <SPEC-OBJECT-TYPE IDENTIFIER="ST-SUB" LONG-NAME="Naval Safety Requirement">
          <SPEC-ATTRIBUTES>
            <ATTRIBUTE-DEFINITION-STRING IDENTIFIER="AD-DESC" LONG-NAME="Description" IS-MANDATORY="true">
              <TYPE><DATATYPE-DEFINITION-STRING-REF>DT-STR</DATATYPE-DEFINITION-STRING-REF></TYPE>
            </ATTRIBUTE-DEFINITION-STRING>
          </SPEC-ATTRIBUTES>
        </SPEC-OBJECT-TYPE>
      </SPEC-TYPES>
      <SPEC-OBJECTS>
        <SPEC-OBJECT IDENTIFIER="SUB-HULL-01" LONG-NAME="Collapse Depth Safety Factor">
          <TYPE><SPEC-OBJECT-TYPE-REF>ST-SUB</SPEC-OBJECT-TYPE-REF></TYPE>
          <VALUES>
            <ATTRIBUTE-VALUE-STRING>
              <DEFINITION><ATTRIBUTE-DEFINITION-STRING-REF>AD-DESC</ATTRIBUTE-DEFINITION-STRING-REF></DEFINITION>
              <THE-VALUE>Pressure hull collapse depth must be >= 600 m with safety factor 1.5 over test depth.</THE-VALUE>
            </ATTRIBUTE-VALUE-STRING>
          </VALUES>
        </SPEC-OBJECT>
        <SPEC-OBJECT IDENTIFIER="SUB-HULL-02" LONG-NAME="Maximum Hoop Stress">
          <TYPE><SPEC-OBJECT-TYPE-REF>ST-SUB</SPEC-OBJECT-TYPE-REF></TYPE>
          <VALUES>
            <ATTRIBUTE-VALUE-STRING>
              <DEFINITION><ATTRIBUTE-DEFINITION-STRING-REF>AD-DESC</ATTRIBUTE-DEFINITION-STRING-REF></DEFINITION>
              <THE-VALUE>HY-100 hull plating hoop stress at test depth must be <= 460 MPa.</THE-VALUE>
            </ATTRIBUTE-VALUE-STRING>
          </VALUES>
        </SPEC-OBJECT>
        <SPEC-OBJECT IDENTIFIER="SUB-LIFE-01" LONG-NAME="Cabin CO2 Partial Pressure Limit">
          <TYPE><SPEC-OBJECT-TYPE-REF>ST-SUB</SPEC-OBJECT-TYPE-REF></TYPE>
          <VALUES>
            <ATTRIBUTE-VALUE-STRING>
              <DEFINITION><ATTRIBUTE-DEFINITION-STRING-REF>AD-DESC</ATTRIBUTE-DEFINITION-STRING-REF></DEFINITION>
              <THE-VALUE>Atmosphere scrubber shall maintain cabin CO2 concentration <= 0.5 percent.</THE-VALUE>
            </ATTRIBUTE-VALUE-STRING>
          </VALUES>
        </SPEC-OBJECT>
        <SPEC-OBJECT IDENTIFIER="SUB-LIFE-02" LONG-NAME="Minimum Oxygen Reserve">
          <TYPE><SPEC-OBJECT-TYPE-REF>ST-SUB</SPEC-OBJECT-TYPE-REF></TYPE>
          <VALUES>
            <ATTRIBUTE-VALUE-STRING>
              <DEFINITION><ATTRIBUTE-DEFINITION-STRING-REF>AD-DESC</ATTRIBUTE-DEFINITION-STRING-REF></DEFINITION>
              <THE-VALUE>Emergency oxygen bank endurance must be >= 168 h for full crew complement.</THE-VALUE>
            </ATTRIBUTE-VALUE-STRING>
          </VALUES>
        </SPEC-OBJECT>
      </SPEC-OBJECTS>
      <SPEC-RELATIONS>
